profile.headline: Motivated self-managing software professional adaptable to meet business needs.
profile.summary:
Deeply skilled in Java programming, debugging and performance analysis. Experience in all phases of software development lifecycle including Development, Test, System Test, Level 3 support, Level 2 support and documentation. Determined, effective problem solver delivering high quality results in wide range of functionalities / components. Highly capable of adapting to new assignments. 

Effective communicator bringing quality solutions to clients through efficient and effective communication of relevant information.  Comfortable and effective with remote collaboration and critical problem solving in global environment. 

Able to quickly understand, break down tasks and ask pertinent questions to produce quality deliverables regardless of role. 

In 2014 I took on the challenge of being a Les Mills certified group fitness instructor. This unique experience has increasing my leadership skills and ability to deliver in my Software career.

positions.description: Assigned to MasterCard working as an SDET for eCommerce solutions.

positions.title: Software Engineer | Support Engineer
positions.description:
Utilized technical skills in Java to identify root cause of issues and collaborated with colleagues from different components, products, job roles and locations to resolve complex issues. Focused on Java heap and performance analysis. 
•	Utilized strong technical skills, research skills and collaborative abilities to drive cases to quick resolution, resulting in high client satisfaction (consistent passive to promoter NPS ratings). 
•	Accessed Java source code to resolve issues. 
•	Managed cases by clearly outlining findings and next steps to prevent escalations and handled escalations through effective communication to client and management. 
•	Identified and documented resolutions to common pain points enabling clients to self-resolve issues.
•	Shared memory analysis and performance analysis skills with colleagues via TechShare meetings and one-on-one to improve skill base and effectiveness of team. 
•	Recognized by colleagues and management for strong work ethic and meeting commitments to clients.
•	Maintained case workload and resolution rate higher than colleagues. 
•	Prioritized cases and workload finding balance between client’s and business needs. 
Products Supported:
Websphere Process Server (WPS), Business Process Manager (BPM), IBM Operational Decision Manager (ODM)

positions.title: Software Engineer | Developer and Tester
positions.description:
Recognized for high quality on-time deliverables, sharp debugging skills and self-management. Part of first teams to follow Agile Development practices. Provided experience in Software Development Lifecycle including Development, Test, System Test, Level 3 support and documentation. Collaborated with colleagues on site as well as remote global teams, some assignments required working entirely with remote teams.
•	Focused on quality. Found and debugged issues, contributing to components outside immediate story or line item. 
•	Reduced defect backlog by 2/3rds after taking leadership of Support Development for WebSphere SCA Feature Pack. 
•	Took initiative to find and fix series of memory leaks not reported by clients during Support Development assignment.
•	Attended calls with designated client to understand pain points and advocate for client in software development process.  
•	Mentored interns and colleagues with less seniority to contribute to career development of others. 
•	Evaluated as “above average” or “top” contributor every year for WebSphere Application Server components.
Development and Test Projects: 
o	Delivered Java code for JMS binding, OGSI implementation, Spring Implementation for Websphere SCA (Service Component Architecture) Feature Pack in accordance with OASIS SCA implementation specification following Agile Development practices. 
o	Researched requirements and learned required technologies for compliant and quality code. 
o	Contributed to design discussions and stories for Websphere SCA Feature pack. 
o	Designed for test plan, Junit automated tests, sample application code and documentation for assigned components.
o	Implemented and delivered Java code fixes back to open source Apache Tuscany project. 
o	Developed Admin Console panels for Websphere Webservices Feature Pack and SCA Feature Pack leveraging Java Apache struts and JSPs.
o	Created test plans and automated integration testcases for WebSphere Application Server for z/OS.

positions.title: Software Engineer Intern | Function Tester
positions.description:
Transitioned from onsite intern to remote intern until joining Websphere Application Server for z/OS team as full-time employee. 
•	Programmed in XML, Python, and UNIX Shell scripts for IBM internal AIS driver framework to configure WebSphere Application Server and automatically report regression test results leading to quicker testing turnaround. 
•	Documented automation procedures allowing colleagues to automate additional tests.
